title: 1789 Capital participated in Vulcan Elements Series A
summary: Vulcan announced a $65 million Series A and separately identified 1789 Capital as a participating investor; the size of 1789's stake was not disclosed.

sources.title: Vulcan Elements Announces $65 Million Series A
Vulcan Elements Series A investor announcement

data.name: Vulcan Elements $65 million Series A
data.description: Series A led by Altimeter Capital with participation from One Investment Management, 1789 Capital, Ibex Investors, nvp capital and others.
data.outcome: Vulcan raised $65 million; 1789 Capital became a disclosed participating investor.

caveats: The $65 million is the total round, not 1789 Capital's individual investment.
